items.evidence: leverage play --ticks 5: screen title, one JSON object with tick, screen, menu_index, language, volume, difficulty, texts, score, best, coins, wave, gate_health, guard_y, quick, heavy, saved, enemies, bolts.
README frame command (--frame frame.png --size 800x480) wrote a PNG; `file` says 800 x 480 RGBA; image shows the field, HUD, guard, walkers, bolts.
Fresh run: texts [Hold the gate: the long night, Best: 0, Start, Settings, Quit], no Continue; 2:enter -> tick 3 screen play, wave 1, score 0, coins 0, gate_health 10, first walker at x=20.

Settings: volume 8 -> right x5 stays at 10, left x10 stays at 0; language en->es->fr, right again stays fr, left back to en and stays; difficulty normal by default, right -> hard (stays), left -> normal -> easy (stays).

With language es and fr (kept), texts of title, settings, play, shop (incl. 'al maximo'/'au maximum' labels), paused, won, lost were all translated (e.g. Tienda/Boutique, Pausa/Reanudar/Titulo, Has ganado/Vous avez gagne, Intro: titulo/Entree : titre); only the game's name stays English.

Run 1 with --settings kA set volume 0, language fr, difficulty normal (and earlier hard); run 2 same folder started at title with volume 0, fr, those values; a new empty folder started with volume 8, en, normal.
Holding up: guard_y 6 -> 6.1 after one tick (6 u/s), 12 at tick 63 and stays 12; holding down: 6 at tick 180, 0 at tick 240 and stays 0.
Held shoot: bolts appear at ticks 31, 55, 79 (24 apart, never more); bolt x grows 0.2333/tick (14 u/s); a bolt at 19.97 is gone the next tick (none past 20).
Seed 1: walkers enter at ticks 3, 93, 183, ... (90 ticks), x=20, health 2, moving 0.025/tick (1.5 u/s), lanes 4,10,6,2,6; wave 1 had exactly 5 then the shop opened.
Guard at y=4: first bolt hit walker at tick 92 (health 2->1, bolt gone), second hit destroyed it: score 10, coins 1. Bolts at y=6 flew past a walker at y=10 (health stayed 2).

Walker reached x=0 at tick 803: removed, gate 10->9, score/coins unchanged. Continuing with no shooting into wave 2, gate reached 0 and screen lost with texts [You lost, Score: 0, Best: 0, Enter: title].
Difficulty set to easy then Start: gate_health 14 (Gate: 14); set to hard then Start: gate_health 7.

Last wave-1 walker gone at tick 1163 -> screen shop; texts [Shop, Coins: 0, Next: wave 2 of 8, Quick hands 0/2 - 5 coins, Heavy bolts 0/1 - 12 coins, Mason: gate 5/10 - 4 coins, Next wave]; with up+shoot held, guard_y and a leftover bolt stayed frozen for 140 ticks.

--set coins=5, Quick hands once: coins 0, quick 1, held shoot fired at 1201, 1219, 1237 (18 ticks). With coins=40: quick 2 for 10 more (coins 25), bolts every 12 ticks (1201, 1213, 1225, 1237); third Enter left coins 25, quick 2.
Heavy bought for 12 (coins 25->13, heavy 1); second Enter changed nothing. In wave 2 a single bolt destroyed a 2-health walker at tick 1276 (score 10, coins +1).
Gate 5/10: Mason -> gate 8, coins 13->9; again -> gate 10 (capped), coins 5; again at 10 -> unchanged. With 0 coins and gate 5, Enter on Mason changed nothing.
Enter on Next wave at tick 1176 -> play at 1177 with 'Wave 2 of 8'; first enemy at tick 1237 (60 later); 7 walkers present at tick 1777, no more after.
--set wave=3: 6 walkers then 4 runners, one every 72 ticks (runners at 435, 507, 579, 651); runner health 1, x falls 0.05/tick (3 u/s); shooting one gave score 15, coins 1.
--set wave=4: 8 walkers then 1 brute at tick 579, health 6, 1/60 unit a tick; shot down: score 40, coins 3; on easy, brute reaching the gate took it 6 -> 3.
modules/work/waves.json holds per wave walker/runner/brute counts and 'every' seconds; the code reads it (include_str); README 'How to change a wave' explains it.

From a kept save at the wave-7 shop (easy, score 500), bought upgrades and played wave 8 with a sweep: screen won, score 1160 = 500 + 380 points of all 22 enemies + 20 x 14 gate; Enter -> title. Waves 1-4 ending into the shop were seen separately; a full scripted run from wave 1 was not achieved (my script lost on wave 3).
Escape at tick 100 -> paused [Paused, Resume, Title]; enemies, bolts, guard frozen through tick 200; Enter on Resume -> play continuing from the same positions; Down+Enter on Title -> title screen.
saved false at tick 1162, true at 1163 when the shop opened; settings.json kept.run written; next run with same folder: title texts [.., Best: 0, Start, Continue, Settings, Quit].
After buying Quick hands (coins 10->5) and ending the run, Continue opened the shop with wave 1, score 0, coins 5, gate 5, quick 1; Next wave played Wave 2 of 8 with the first enemy 60 ticks later.

Start -> saved false, next run's title has no Continue; continued run lost in wave 2 -> saved false, no Continue next run; won run -> saved false; Title from pause left kept.run unchanged (Continue still on title).
Won with 1160 -> title 'Best: 1,160', and in a later run; a later lost run with score 0 left best 1160 (lost screen shows Best: 1,160); won and lost screens show Best.
Two runs seed 5, same script, each from its own copy of the same kept folder: outputs byte-identical (same md5). Seeds 1, 2, 3 put wave-1 walkers in lanes 4,10,6,2,6 / 10,10,6,10,8 / 2,4,6,4,2.

Wave-8 frame at tick 960: gate strip at left, guard at (2,0), green walkers, small yellow runners, large red brutes and a bolt at the pixel positions the state gives (40 px a unit); HUD shows Score, Coins, Wave 8 of 8, Gate: 4.

Title frame (en) with Continue ringed (menu_index 1); settings frame in French with 'Langue : Francais' ringed; shop frame in Spanish with 'Saetas pesadas' ringed. (A stray '@hud.pause' label also shows; see defects.)
assets/strings/en.json, es.json, fr.json, same keys; no words in lib.rs; README 'How to add a language' explains copying en.json.
README has how to play, where kept (--settings folder settings.json: volume, language, difficulty, kept.best, kept.run), and both check commands, which I ran as written and which worked.

defects: Escape in the shop is not ignored: after Escape there, Down/Enter on Next wave did nothing for 220+ ticks (game stalls until Escape is pressed again); the brief says Escape does nothing there. README admits it.
Every frame of title, settings and shop (and under the HUD in play) shows an unresolved '@hud.pause' label top-left, a raw string key, untranslated in every language.
Title and shop frames paint one entry blue (Start, Next wave) besides the focus ring on the chosen entry, so two entries look marked.
menu_index is null on the play and paused screens.
Bolts still in flight when the shop opens stay frozen and carry into the next wave; enemies stay in the state on the lost screen.

trace.how: context, new, read_again and how far the context grew are the run's own records. written_out a request is its growth less its answers (characters / 4), scaled to the run's exact total; of_which_unseen is that less the visible text (thinking). cost is what the request read and wrote, weighted; carried is what reading again what it added cost at every later request (start.carried: the same for what every request starts from). reading + writing is in_the_ledger
